iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: COMPREHENSIVE. All target fields are covered by at least one, and most by multiple, accepted source candidates. Dated case/death/hospitalization snapshots span the full August 2025 window (Aug 1–29) from primary DOHMH sources. The outbreak arc from initial cluster declaration through closure is fully documented. Locality is resolved to Central Harlem ZIP codes. The final confirmed totals (7 deaths, 130+ cases by closure) are anchored to the August 29 DOHMH primary press release. Intermediate snapshots provide granular time-series data for the entire month.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: HIGH. The primary evidence chain runs through nyc.gov (DOHMH press releases and HAN alerts) — the authoritative source for NYC Legionnaires' disease surveillance. All key numerical claims (case counts, death tolls, hospitalization figures) are traceable to DOHMH primary sources or direct Mayor's Office transcripts. Secondary sources (news, aggregators) consistently cite DOHMH as their source, providing corroboration without introducing independent unverifiable claims. The BMJ article adds international peer-reviewed validation. The NYS EP Alert provides independent state-level corroboration of the August 15 snapshot. No significant trust concerns remain; the duplicate URL issue from search results is a search-engine artifact, not a data quality problem.
